description: Prepares the exact call to the Agent Output Verifier for one output: request_body, and send with the free paths (MCP, and REST when the verifier says so) and the paid path, read from the verifier's live documents. Give listing_id (its template) or an inline output_schema. It never evaluates or sends anything. Free.

inline_template.description: true: put a template over 3 KB into request_body (default: a placeholder; get it with get_template).

listing_id.description: Use this listing's template; or give output_schema.

submitted_output.description: The output to check, as JSON (request bodies up to 64 KB).

task_id.description: Your id for this check; derived from the content if omitted.

trace_id.description: From a previous response, to continue it; omit on the first call.

name: prepare_verification
title: Prepare a verifier call
